subject.title: [Bug]: Regression: User-configured heartbeat prompt no longer respected

question: Should maintainers refresh the open conflicting cross-repo fix PR for this issue, or close/supersede it and allow a new narrow same-repo repair?
rationale: The bug remains source-reproducible, but an open linked PR uses closing syntax and the issue carries no-new-fix-pr state, so automation should not create a competing fix until maintainers pick the canonical repair path.

options.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting cross-repo path and sponsor a focused same-repo fix covering custom-prompt mutation and prompt-boundary visibility.

options.title: Refresh The Cross-Repo PR
options.body: Ask the PR author or a maintainer to rebase it, add real behavior proof, and update coverage against current heartbeat prompt assembly.

options.title: Pause For Owner Triage
options.body: Keep this issue open without new repair automation until the heartbeat prompt-boundary owner decides the exact fix shape.

recommendation.title: Replace With Same-Repo Repair
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting cross-repo path and sponsor a focused same-repo fix covering custom-prompt mutation and prompt-boundary visibility.
